Identified as this saint because: Found by reading the Commons category off Wikidata — Q4321322, «Нил Столбенски», a Russian monk canonised by the Orthodox church — which gives `Category:Nil Stolobensky`. The file's title names him in full with his by-name, «прп. Нила Столобенского», which is this folder's own stored Russian form «Нил Столобенский» exactly, and describes the object as the temple icon with a particle of his relics, at the Nilo-Stolobensky hermitage he founded. Distinct from `nilus-of-sora`, whose by-name is Сорский, and from Nilus of Sinai. 2848x4272. Commons describes it: Temple icon of St. Neil Stolobensky
